act5/camp/frost_camp.title: Embers Under the Storm
act5/camp/frost_camp.body:
Pilgrims share warmth in **shards**; the fire **consumes** — one truth: **no one** ascends whole.

*No calendar in the storm: **day {{day}}**.* If the wind stills, it may be an **ambush** tuning the bow.

choices.text: Rest by the brazier (−1 supply)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to pay for rest.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Exchange a few words with the group
choices.lockedHint: Without a companion, there is no group to talk to.

choices.text: Manage equipment at camp
Share a prayer with devotees of the Third Bell
choices.preview: +1 faith, +1 corruption (once)
diaryTexts: The embers drew an invisible bell — no one struck it, but everyone heard.

choices.text: Ask the Vigil for escort of thought (against the Cult)
choices.preview: Cult falls; Vigil rises (slow) (once)
diaryTexts: A cloak-bearer traced a line in the snow between me and the rumor of the bell.

choices.text: Consecrate melted snow as holy water (cleric)
choices.preview: −1 supply · +2 faith (once)
diaryTexts: I melted snow in the staff's tin until my hand ached — God listens better when flesh pays the heat.

choices.text: Bury two coins in the ice for the Third Bell
choices.preview: −2 gold · cult +1 · +1 corruption (once)
diaryTexts: The ice swallowed the gold without sound — the rumor of the bell drew closer, or my ear gave way.

choices.text: Move on

act5/camp/frost_companion_chat.title: Word Beside the Fire
act5/camp/frost_companion_chat.body:
{{companionLine}}

The wind fills the other's place when you fall silent — and even then it feels like a replica of conversation. The low sky helps: no one demands bravery when the cold seems to have an opinion.

choices.text: Listen to Mira without letting the snow decide for you
Sit beside Tomás — shield and storm
Stand between the two — two blades, one fire
Mira: "You still carry the wall on your back — the cold does not forgive that"
Mira: "Do your symbols melt snow? Or is it the other way around?"
Mira: "Well, cleric — do you still pray up here, or only breathe?"
Tomás: "The ice favors those who already carry guilt in their steel"
Tomás: "Mana does not warm; but it burns inside like crooked faith"
Tomás: "If the Vigil heard you now, would it approve the silence?"
Return to the frozen camp

act5/camp/frost_duo_fireside.title: Two Blades, One Fire
act5/camp/frost_duo_fireside.body:
**Mira** and **Tomás** **weigh** words at the fire — she wants a **name** for leaving; he straightens the shield: *order is a **place** where no one falls alone.*

You are not arbiter — **witness**.

---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Interrupt before the cold enters the conversation

act5/camp/frost_mira_fireside.title: Ice — Confidences with Mira
act5/camp/frost_mira_fireside.body:
**Mira** uses the wind instead of shrinking; at the fire, your face **doubles** for an instant — an old trick from below.

You still **descend** — the ceiling only **changed** shape.

> *"Snow **erases footprints"*, she says. "Choose what you want to forget."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the cold returned something she lost
Speak of the summit as one speaks of a sentence
Return to the fire circle

act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_pact.title: Pact with the Cold
act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_pact.body:
> *"The cold returns nothing,"* Mira laughs, dry. *"It only **hardens** what stayed with you. I did not come to the mountain for longing — I came because climbing alone is folly, and with you it is still business."*

She kicks a dead ember back into the light.

> *"If this is a pact, let it be short. Long pacts turn into chains."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Do not press — the wind already speaks loud enough

act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_summit.title: The Summit Ahead
act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_summit.body:
Mira looks into the darkness above the pass.

> *"The summit is not victory. It is **exposure**. The sky likes to see who trembles first — I will not give that spectacle for free."*

She crosses her arms.

> *"When we climb, do not ask me for heroism. Ask for **clarity**. I cut what stands in front."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the group's relative warmth

act5/camp/frost_tomas_fireside.title: Ice — Word with Tomás
act5/camp/frost_tomas_fireside.body:
**Tomás** rubs his hands without drama; the shield close, **second skin**. **Same** wound, **different** ceiling.

> *"The mountain is not the enemy — the enemy is **confusing** weariness with a sign from God."* The shadow on the metal reminds you: **posture** is also a mask.
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the rope still gnawed his palm
Speak of the temple as of a battlefield
Return to the fire circle

act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_rope.title: The Mark of the Rope
act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_rope.body:
He opens his palm for an instant — pink lines, living memory.

> *"The rope remembers when I do not want it to. Good: it **reminds** me to fall with care."*

Tomás breathes deep.

> *"If we climb together, I do not need you to save me — I need you not to invent victory before its time. The ice loves **haste**."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Let the matter close with the wind

act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_temple.title: Temple in the Ice
act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_temple.body:
> *"Black stone is not morality,"* Tomás murmurs. *"It is **weight**. The temple will ask for knees — I give knees from habit, not for show. If voices wait inside, remember: echo is not order."*

He taps the shield lightly.

> *"I go first when the ground is doubtful. Not from bravery — from **measure**."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the camp's warmth
diaryTexts: Tomás spoke of the summit as a line — not glory, but duty. His shield still casts a shadow larger than he admits.

act5/camp/manage_equip.title: Buckles in the White Wind
act5/camp/manage_equip.body:
The wind sharpens every gesture. Cold steel, stiff leather straps, numb fingers.

Between one gust and the next, you reorganize what keeps you whole: **weapon**, **armor**, and **relics**.

choices.text: Return to the camp on the ice

act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon.title: Vetrnax Awakens
act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon.body: **Vetrnax** uncoils his neck like a **rope** of thunder. The first assault is not teeth — it is **cold** that steals the sound from your tongue. The air **vibrates** before the blow: the dragon does not attack only the body; it attacks the **certainty** that you are still alive.

choices.text: First phase — breath freezes the air
Fall back — return to the pass

act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon_2.title: Silence of Ice
act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon_2.body:
The dragon **tears** its own roar and lets in a **silence** worse than the noise.

In its chest, something **pulses** — not blood, but a **note** trapped, like a bell fused to bone.

If you break it, the Third Bell hears — or **falls silent** forever.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Second phase — break the heart of frost

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_cultist.title: Stranger on the Ice
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_cultist.body:
Someone **sings** low — not a prayer, a **measure** that does not match the wind. His eyes have already **sold** the sky to another bell. Snow clings to his beard like **blessed ash**; beneath the skin, however, there is **fever**.

This is not a duel of ideas — it is **luck** against **fanaticism**. One of you will leave with the **cheaper** name.

choices.text: Answer the cultist lost in the pass

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_howl_hor.title: Howl of the Storm
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_howl_hor.body:
When the wind **turns**, you see four shapes: three whelps and a **frost raider** cutting a path like a living **axe**. The howl does not come from the throat — it comes from **metal** and **bone** combining hunger.

It is rare to see so many mouths in one place. When the range **gathers** a pack like this, either there is **prey**, or there is **desperation**.

choices.text: Hold the line against the horde

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_hunt_par.title: Hunting Pack
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_hunt_par.body:
Three silhouettes close the circle: two frost whelps and a **fanatic** in torn robes, all hungry for another's **warmth**. The cultist whistles a **measure** that does not match the wind — the whelps only want to know if your blood is still **hot**.

If you hesitate, the ice **closes** the contract for you.

choices.text: Face the hunting band

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_solo_whe.title: Lost Whelp
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_solo_whe.body:
A single **whelp** followed you by the echo of your steps — curiosity or **hunger**, the result is the same. It looks at you as one reads **price** in a shop window: no shame, only **cold calculation**.

If you let it go, it will not thank you — it will **learn** your scent for next time.

choices.text: Face the lone whelp

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_whelps.title: Whelps in the Blizzard
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_whelps.body:
From the **white** leap two hungry silhouettes — not the mission's ambush; the mountain **collecting** a visit. Teeth **clink** like glass; breath smells of **deferred storm**.

If you win, you learn a rough rule: on the range, **hunger** is more faithful than any map.

choices.text: Drive off the frost whelps

act5/encounters/frost_snow_mountains_com.title: Passage to the Cave Mouth
act5/encounters/frost_snow_mountains_com.body:
The rumor did not lie entirely: before the stone that looks like a **mouth**, the mountain demands a **toll** of teeth. Two small shadows cut the white — hunger with form, not ideology.

If you pass, you do not thank chance. You thank **your** body for still knowing how to **fall** standing.

choices.text: Cross the frost whelps guarding the path

act5/encounters/frost_stranded_traveler.title: Traveler in the Crevasse
act5/encounters/frost_stranded_traveler.body:
A **mule** trapped in the ice — hooves at the crevasse's mercy, eye white with panic. The owner **bites** his lip: *"I only need rope and someone who still believes in pulling."*

Either you believe — or the world **charges** you for not having spared it.

choices.text: Spend rope and warmth — pull the mule to safety
choices.preview: −1 supply · +1 faith
choices.lockedHint: Without supply there is no spare rope or warmth for the act of saving — you need at least 1.
diaryTexts: The snow does not thank you — but the traveler does, with a look that asks no name.

choices.text: Cut the pack and move on before it screams
choices.preview: +6 gold · +1 corruption · Vigil −5
diaryTexts: The ice covered the scream; the gold in your pocket does not warm.

act5/encounters/frost_whelp_pack.title: Den of Frost Whelps
act5/encounters/frost_whelp_pack.body:
Two **whelps** circle you, hungry for living warmth. Their eyes are **holes** where moonlight was frozen — and where your reflection **hesitates** a second longer than it should.

If you pass, the den stops being rumor — it becomes a **door**. After this, there is no **turning back** that does not cost blood or pride.

choices.text: Fight the frost whelps

act5/frost_epilogue.title: Frost Epilogue
act5/frost_epilogue.body:
**Vetrnax** turns to **waterfall**; the wind stops biting and **whispers** empty order — an instant when silence weighs more than the roar.

In your hand, a **scale** that burns cold: a trophy that likes to **turn** into guilt. The rumor will change — dead or **sleeping** deeper.

You know the **damp** truth: every victory is a **rope**; the Bell favors those who pull without complaint.

choices.text: Follow the echo under the ice — cross the Void Threshold

onEnterDiaryTexts: Vetrnax fell. The ice split like glass — and beneath, for an instant, I heard the Third Bell learning a new name.

act5/frost_hub.title: Pass — Improvised Camp
act5/frost_hub.body:
**Tents** creak like old teeth; the fire **threatens** more than it warms. **Same** weight of silence, **larger** stage: snow, **human** tracks, **bestial** tracks, and a third with no name.

The map here is **decision** — rumor, **exchange** of warmth, or letting the snow **choose**. The pass only **covers**.

choices.text: Patrol the pass (explore map)
choices.preview: Walk the ice with risk of encounter and rising stress.

choices.text: Follow the claw trail in the snow (quest)
choices.preview: Trail, ambush, or hunt — the snow does not judge.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 18 and must first reach the temple trail on the pass map (patrol from camp).

choices.text: Squire's rumor — rope and ritual on the ice
choices.preview: Tomás's story; rope and ice — but the rumor cools after day 15.

choices.text: Squire's rumor — only echo and empty rope on the ice
choices.preview: Too late; the pass has already learned another name for justice.

choices.text: Live the camp on the ice
choices.preview: Rest, supply, and talk by the fire.

choices.text: Thunder-blue tent merchant
choices.preview: Gold and item trade; the price of cold.

choices.text: Snow mountains — rumor of a monk in the cave
choices.preview: Cave and the monk's trials; peace or banishment.

choices.text: Toward the summit — black stone temple (dangerous path)
choices.preview: Dangerous ascent to the temple and what sleeps on the summit.
choices.lockedHint: The summit requires level 22 and finding the temple trail on the map first.

act5/frost_lair_approach.title: Approach to the Ice Lair
act5/frost_lair_approach.body:
**Ice** mirrors the face in slices — none **whole**; below, **teeth** of winter open a smile that is not for you.

The air turns to **needles**; the sky hesitates to fall, as one holding a **secret** too heavy to bear.

choices.text: Enter the chamber of white breath
Turn your face to the wind — the gray trail waits
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: Return to camp

onEnterDiaryTexts: The lair does not smell of brimstone — it smells of deferred storm. Vetrnax sleeps awake.

act5/frost_merchant.title: Frost Merchant's Tent
act5/frost_merchant.body:
Inside the tent, flasks **tremble** like tongues. The merchant shows no face — only **prices** that do not freeze. It smells of **burned herbs** and of **fear** from those who need remedy in the middle of a war with the sky.

> **Limited** stock. The wind charges interest to those who **hesitate** — and real interest charges those who pretend they need nothing.

choices.text: Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Blue Tonic (10 gold) (×1)
Buy Mead (4 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (10 gold) (×1)
Buy Last Supply (15 gold) (×1)
Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the tent

act5/frost_monk/banished.title: The Cave Closes
act5/frost_monk/banished.body:
The cave **refuses** you — **narrow** air, dry voice: *return to where you can still lie with comfort.*

The mountain **pushes** you out; **there is no return** to that mouth — only **snow** pretending neutrality.

choices.text: Descend alone — the mountain does not argue

onEnterDiaryTexts: I failed in the monk's cave. The wind pushed me out as one removes the wrong object from a drawer — and I heard the stone close from within. There is no second entrance: that path ended.

act5/frost_monk/trial_agi.title: Third Question — Body on the Ice of Decision
act5/frost_monk/trial_agi.body:
Plates beneath your boots **lie** about firmness — *do not speak; **take** a step without betraying balance; whoever stumbles **vanishes**.*

Courage without precision is **haste**. **Roll the skill check** — or the mountain decides.

act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.title: Second Question — What Cannot Be Controlled
act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.body:
A low **laugh**, frost cracking: *now it is not idea — it is **fall** and **luck**.*

The cave **tilts**; the next step may be yours or belong to whoever believed too much in control. **Roll luck** when you are ready.
act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.luckCheckLabel: Accept chance without lying to your body (Luck)

act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.title: First Question — The Weight of Thought
act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.body:
A shadow without face, only quiet **habit** — *speak a truth you **hate** knowing.*

The cave does not punish failure: it **closes**. **Roll the skill check** when you are ready.
act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.skillCheckLabel: Listen to the end without your mind fleeing (Mind)

act5/frost_monk/triumph.title: Blessing of Quiet Snow
act5/frost_monk/triumph.body:
The monk **inclines** his head — *do not take me; take this: the world throws dice, and you learned to look without asking for a trick.*

Something **settles** in your chest: **+1 LCK**, forever, like a silent **passive**. The cave only **breathes** when you leave.

choices.text: Return to the pass — carry the silence in your chest

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the cave above the storm, a faceless monk gave me a strange blessing: not promise, not miracle — only the certainty that luck can also be discipline. I gained the Inner Peace passive: +1 LCK, forever.

act5/frost_opening.title: Graywind Heights

choices.text: Find shelter and plan on the snow

onEnterDiaryTexts: After the throne: ice corridors, dungeon air, lying sky. Rumor of a dragon in the Heights — only the sky hesitates.

act5/frost_ridgeline.title: Ridge of the Frozen Range
act5/frost_ridgeline.body:
The **range** does not welcome — air like a **blade**, breath **charging** the chest.

A distant **crack** — ice **splitting** under impossible weight; **tracks** not human and **blue crystals** in the snow. To follow is **wager**, not destiny.

choices.text: Follow the claw trail in the snow
Return to camp

onEnterDiaryTexts: The snow does not lie: something large slid here. And something small still lurks.

act5/frost_snow_gruta_approach.title: Stone Mouth and Warm Breath
act5/frost_snow_gruta_approach.body:
The mouth **absorbs**; inside, **warm** air that teaches ice to **lie** about temperature.

An **echo** asks: *who brings noise to a place that only wants to **remember**?* To err here is not to die — it is to **leave** with memory cut away.

choices.text: Enter the cave — accept what inside asks no permission

act5/frost_snow_mountains_enter.title: Ascent to the Snow Mountains
act5/frost_snow_mountains_enter.body:
Above the line where the **storm** falls silent, they say a **cave** breathes — trail only in **whisper** and in those who returned **half** from there.

The snow **asks** if you still need the name; to climb is **pilgrimage** or **flight** in a cloak of courage.

choices.text: Follow the rumor — climb until the wind goes quiet

act5/frost_summit/ascend.title: Trail to the Summit
act5/frost_summit/ascend.body:
The **range** sharpens into **teeth** of basalt — a path the body pays in **short breath** and **quiet fear**.

On the **summit**, they say those who returned **half**, **black stone** breathes slower than snow: not promise — **bait**.

choices.text: Follow the line of stone that bites the sky

onEnterDiaryTexts: I climbed where the map ends. The wind here does not apologize — it demands witnesses.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: The Throne Answers
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body:
An ancient **noise** — not thunder, but **memory** with teeth — tears the air. From the altar rises a **form** that was number before it had a face: **echoes** of the broken pantheon, hungry for **name** and **measure**.

If you flee, the temple **remembers**. If you stay, the temple **covers**.

choices.text: Face what descended from the pantheon

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: Curse of the Throne
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body:
Defeat comes not only in **wound**. It comes in **form** — a **hand** in the inner mirror pulling you down, **three times** on **three fronts**: body, reflection, will.

You rise because **fear** still pushes — but the world, for a time, **denies** you ease. Every step is **proof**. Every thought is **cost**.

choices.text: Drag myself out of the temple — alive, but hollow

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost to the echo — and the temple left me a curse that is not confessed, only carried.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: Fallen God
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body:
The silence, after the fall, is not **consolation**. It is **contract** read in a low voice. Something in you **stays** with the wrong name in the right place: **fallen god** — not promise, **title** that weighs.

In the chest's clock, the **amulet** pulses when corruption **throbs**: hungry, **useful**, dangerous. It does not forgive — it **feeds**.

choices.text: Leave the summit — with the new weight in your chest

onEnterDiaryTexts: I defeated a pantheon echo. The title does not warm — but the amulet burns where corruption bites.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_1.title: First Blockade
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_1.body:
The ice **deceives**: it looks like silence, but it is **ambush** with claws. A **raider** made this pass home — and a **whelp** still learns to eat **fear** at your heartbeat's pace.

If you retreat, do not call it **prudence**. Call it **survival** — and accept that the summit continues to **exist** without you.

choices.text: Force the ascent — cross the first blockade

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_2.title: Second Blockade
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_2.body:
The air **sharpens** until it hurts. A **cultist** sings a measure that does not match the snow — as if the ritual had already begun **before** you arrived. Beside him, the **raider** drags metal: not music; **warning**.

Every step asks if you still want to **reach** the temple, or if you prefer to become legend of one who fled.

choices.text: Climb higher — the wind worsens before it stills

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_3.title: Last Pass
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_3.body:
Here the wind does not **push** — it **tears**. Several **whelps** circle like a bad idea made flesh; the **cultist** laughs low, as one who already read your end in a **tongue** not taught at an honest altar.

At the top, **black stone** breathes. Either you **gasp** — or it only **listens**.

choices.text: Break the circle — the summit is above

act5/frost_summit/pick_sacrifice.title: Who Pays the Price
act5/frost_summit/pick_sacrifice.body:
The **altar** does not shine; it **absorbs**. Runes eat light as one eats **shame**. To open what sleeps beneath the name "**ancient gods**," someone must **stop being human** in the world — and someone must **pay** that absence in **near** flesh.

Choose with **steady hands**. After this, there is no **pretty excuse**.

choices.text: Offer Mira to the altar — no theater, no return
choices.preview: Without carrying the gesture in time, you retreat to the threshold.

choices.text: Offer Tomás to the altar — oath broken in blood
choices.preview: Without carrying the gesture in time, you retreat to the threshold.

choices.text: I cannot — return to the threshold
choices.preview: Offer your own body (Lose half max HP forever)

onEnterDiaryTexts: The altar asks no name. It asks presence. And I chose who would stay absent.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_altar.title: The Altar That Learns Your Name
act5/frost_summit/ritual_altar.body:
At the **threshold** you thought the cold was only **climate**. Here, at the **center**, you understand it is **fence**: black stone **holds** what should not be seen until someone **arrives** with enough body to **translate** the silence.

The **altar** asks no **prayer**. It asks **substitution** — **flesh** that signs what the ancient gods **did not** want written in **words**. There is no **third** door: either you **accept** the contract, or you **lie** to yourself that you still **matter**.

There is only **one** path from here **inward** to what comes next.

choices.text: Proceed — blood in the ritual, without pretending innocence
choices.preview: Choose who stays outside humanity.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_blood.title: Invocation in Blood
act5/frost_summit/ritual_blood.body:
Blood **darkens** the snow; the air smells of **iron** and **broken oath** — in the temple, something **wakes** by **contract**, not blessing.

**Three seals** — Mind and Strength, three times — or what comes **does not come** as promise.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_pacified.title: Seals Closed
act5/frost_summit/ritual_pacified.body:
For an **instant** — long enough to hurt — the temple goes truly **quiet**. Not peace; **agreement** imposed on something that preferred **hunger**.

The corruption in you **cools**, like embers stepped on. You won no crown or relic — you won **margin**. And margin, on the mountain, is sometimes worth more than **gold**.

choices.text: Accept the gods' retreat — and leave

onEnterDiaryTexts: The seals closed in time. I felt the void recede — not as victory, as truce.

act5/frost_summit/temple_gate.title: Threshold of the Black Stone Temple
act5/frost_summit/temple_gate.body:
On the **summit**, time does not pass — it **accumulates**. Broken pillars hold a roof that no longer protects anything, only **witnesses**. The cold here has a **metallic** taste, like tongue on an ancient blade.

If you stay silent, you hear the **void** arguing with you. If you do not, the void **answers** in the same tongue — and charges **price**.

choices.text: Descend to the pass — the body asks for less altitude
Only contemplate the silence between the pillars
Approach the temple's heart — where silence weighs like a slab
choices.preview: Go to the altar at the temple's depths — and understand what the ritual demands.
choices.lockedHint: You need corruption 7 or higher and at least one companion in the party.

act5/frost_summit/temple_quiet.title: Silence of Stone
act5/frost_summit/temple_quiet.body:
Between **pillars**, snow learns to fall **vertical** — without haste, without forgiveness. There is no music; there is **absence** with form.

If you seek comfort, it is not here. If you seek **truth**, perhaps it is — but truth, in this place, wears the **face** of warning.

choices.text: Return to the threshold

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the temple, silence does not console — it weighs. Like a nail in the conscience.

act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_adv.title: Advantage in the Clearing
act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_adv.body:
You reach the **clearing** in **shadow** — **whelp** sniffing wrong wind; **cultist** with knife at **Tomás's** **throat**. **Silence** pays **interest** in blood.

Tomás **closes** his eyes for **counting**, not fear.

---

*Advantage: you surprised the captors before the final blow.*

choices.text: Strike before the blade wakes

act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_hard.title: The Ice Does Not Forgive
act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_hard.body:
**Crack** under the boot — **too much** give. The **cultist** lifts his face; the **whelp** **hisses**; **Tomás** pulls the **trapped** shield, still **alive**.

Only **fight**; **hesitation** pays **interest** in flesh.

---

*The captors saw you first: combat at disadvantage.*

choices.text: Answer the clash even without surprise

act5/frost_tomas/intro.title: The Squire in the Snow
act5/frost_tomas/intro.body:
Among the rocks, **Tomás** is **bound** to the ice post; two cold **cultists** measure time with **blade** and **prayer**.

This is not romance — it is **debt**; if you leave him, the pass calls that justice.

choices.text: Follow the rumor to the bottom of the clearing
choices.preview: Listen to the ice — or hesitate and return to the pass.

choices.text: Return to the pass

act5/frost_tomas/missed.title: Empty Rope
act5/frost_tomas/missed.body:
The rope **beats** the post; **there is no** Tomás — only **absence** and a **sign** in the snow that is not yours.

An **echo** murmurs that whoever tarries below **pays in another's flesh**; you return to the pass with **empty** hands.

choices.text: Return to the pass

onEnterDiaryTexts: I arrived late to the squire's rumor: only rope beating the post and ice pretending there was never a body.

act5/frost_tomas/rescued.title: The Shield Rises
act5/frost_tomas/rescued.body:
The rope falls; **Tomás** steals air from the sky and grabs the shield like a **name**.

> *"I did not come for you — I came for what you leave behind. Order me to rise, I rise; otherwise, I walk with you."*

**Contract** of iron and silence, not romance.

choices.text: Return to the pass

onEnterDiaryTexts: I pulled Tomás from the rope and the ritual. His shield still trembles — but he swore to follow whoever does not flee first.

act5/frost_tomas/trial.title: Trial of the Trail
act5/frost_tomas/trial.body:
The **snow** hides sound, not the **trail** — **leg** and **judgment**, or the **cultist** turns his head and the **whelp** wakes hungry for **panic**.

**Tomás** bites his lip: he does not see who comes, only **hopes** someone worthy will **raise** the shield again.
act5/frost_tomas/trial.skillCheckLabel: Approach without letting the wind betray you
